subject.title: fix(embeddings): bound openai-compatible requests without AbortSignal

question: Should every unsignaled OpenAI-compatible embedding endpoint, including slow self-hosted servers, be subject to unconditional 60-second query and 120-second batch deadlines?
rationale: The implementation correctly prevents indefinite hangs, but repository evidence does not define a universal maximum latency for all OpenAI-compatible endpoints; choosing that contract changes upgrade behavior and requires owner intent.

options.title: Adopt safer latency bounds
options.body: Retain transport hang protection while choosing longer or provider-aware ceilings that preserve supported slow self-hosted workloads, then prove hung and slow-success cases.

options.title: Approve 60s and 120s
options.body: Accept these values as the new supported contract and explicitly own the upgrade impact for unsignaled requests exceeding either ceiling.

options.title: Design explicit configuration
options.body: Add a setting only if existing provider policy cannot express the needed distinction, accepting the repository cost of another configuration surface.

recommendation.title: Adopt safer latency bounds
recommendation.body: Retain transport hang protection while choosing longer or provider-aware ceilings that preserve supported slow self-hosted workloads, then prove hung and slow-success cases.
